title: The routing floor ignores the builder's sandbox deny list, so items whose fix needs a sandbox-denied path go to lanes that can never finish them
summary: Cycles 1696 and 1699 both FAILED at the build floor on item chronicle-s7a-historian-shadow. The item declares .evolve/profiles/historian.json (new) in its files. The builder profile's sandbox denies every write under .evolve/profiles (deny_subpaths), so TDD wrote a test demanding the profile that the builder could not create, and the floor rejected the build after 3 corrections, twice. The ADR-0074 routing floor (inboxbatch.ConsoleRouted, the claim floor, the wave seed and triage's PartitionConsole) judges declared surfaces only with guards.IsProtectedScope. That compiled integrity manifest names two specific profiles, not the sandbox's deny list. Two sources describe what a lane may not write, and routing consults only one of them. The item is now route=console-sandbox-denied by hand.
fix: Build one routing predicate: guards.IsProtectedScope OR the builder profile's sandbox deny list. That deny list is the single source the OS sandbox already enforces, projected here rather than copied. Add a profiles.Sandbox.Denies(path) projection and a lanerouting.Forbidden(projectRoot) composition, then wire every site that passes guards.IsProtectedScope to routing today (cmd_inbox, cmd_loop_wave, cmd_cycle's claim floor, cmd_inbox_mover, triage's PartitionConsole).
acceptance: An item declaring .evolve/profiles/<new>.json is console-routed while the builder sandbox denies .evolve/profiles (test)
Every routing site uses the composed predicate (wiring pin test)
The deny list is read from the builder profile and never duplicated (a test changes the profile and routing follows)
consumed_by: inbox review 2026-09-27: FIXED. Fixed by #647 (2d58d159, 'fix(routing): no lane is sent work its builder's sandbox forbids'). It added profiles.SandboxConfig.Denies (go/internal/profiles/sandbox.go:11) and lanerouting.Forbidden (go/internal/lanerouting/lanerouting.go:16). laneForbidden (go/cmd/evolve/cmd_lane_routing.go:16) is wired at cmd_cycle.go:443, cmd_inbox.go:73, cmd_inbox_mover.go:29 and cmd_loop_wave.go:30,89,93, and into triage.Config.LaneForbidden. The live console-routed count rose 146 to 147. Its known gaps (m2, m4, m9) were filed as termination-check-uses-no-routing-predicate.
